name: devmode-demo
description: Demo für die Dev-Mode-Präsentation: drei Svelte-Komponenten, Tokens wie in Figma, Code Connect.

scripts.figma:parse: figma connect parse && figma connect parse -c figma.wc.config.json
scripts.figma:dry-run: node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/.bin/figma connect publish --dry-run && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/.bin/figma connect publish -c figma.wc.config.json --dry-run
scripts.figma:publish: node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/.bin/figma connect publish && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/.bin/figma connect publish -c figma.wc.config.json
